d: lon Musk is showing signs of distancing himself from Donald Trump after the Republican Party suffered major setbacks in the 2026 US midterm elections. Speaking virtually at the New York Times DealBook Summit on November 18, the Tesla and SpaceX chief said he felt "pretty foolish" about spending around $446 million on political campaigns, questioning whether the money had delivered meaningful results. Musk also insisted that he was not part of Trump's Make America Great Again (MAGA) movement, marking a shift from his earlier public support for the president.
